subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Presumable
solution:
The correct answer is **"Improbable."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Presumable** means something that is assumed to be true without concrete evidence. (कुछ ऐसा जिसे बिना ठोस सबूत के सच मान लिया जाता है)

 
 
• **Example**: *It is **presumable**__ that important changes are already underway.*
 
 
 
• **Improbable** is the opposite of **presumable**.
 
• **Improbable** means something that is unlikely to happen or be true, not likely to be true or to happen. (जिसके सच निकलने या घटित होने की संभावना नहीं; असंभाव्‍य)
 __
 
• **Example**:* This is an **improbable**__ explanation.*
 
 
 
• The prefix** 'im'** in **Improbable** means** 'not'**, making it an antonym of **Presumable**.
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 - Reasonable**: Reasonable means logical or sensible. (उचित व्‍यवहार और विवेकपूर्ण)
 
• **Option 2 - Forgetful**: Forgetful means having a poor memory or easily forgetting things.
 
• **Option 4 - Credible**: Credible means believable or trustworthy.
